OWNED FILES: storygame/runtime/engine.py, bench/core.py, bench/guard_retry_report.py (NEW), tests/test_guard_retry_telemetry.py (NEW). Edit nothing else.

GOAL: let the live bench measure the guard retry's rescue rate. Today RuntimeEngine.turn (engine.py, loop over TURN_NARRATION_ATTEMPTS, branch that catches ProposalValidationError from self.narration_validator.validate and sets guard_retry_used) retries once, but the bench turn records (bench/core.py, the `turn_record = {...}` dict near 'authored_handoff_candidate_id', and the two `rejected_turns.append({...})` dicts) do not say whether the retry fired or why.

1. In the engine, record each guard rejection that triggers a retry: keep `self.last_guard_rejections: list[dict]` (reset at the start of every turn) with {'code': error.code, 'message': str(error), 'rejected_narration': <the first reply's narration text if available from the proposal, else None>}. This is bench telemetry only: it must never reach a player-facing payload, a provider prompt, save files or the API. Do not change retry behaviour.
2. In bench/core.py add to every successful turn record: `guard_retry_used` (from engine.state.last_turn_delivery.guard_retry_used), `guard_rejections` (copy of engine.last_guard_rejections). Add the same `guard_rejections` and `guard_retry_used` fields to both rejected_turns entries (a turn where the retry also failed: use the engine list; guard_retry_used True when the list is non-empty). Non-runtime paths without an engine write empty values.
3. NEW bench/guard_retry_report.py: `python -m bench.guard_retry_report --in A/all-turn-records.json [--in B/...] --out-json X --out-md Y`. Pure function over records (no network). Per script and overall it prints EVERY turn (successes included): script, replicate, typed input, outcome (committed_clean | committed_after_retry | failed_after_retry | failed_other), first rejection code, whether the final narration (when committed) still contains the rejected protected term (case-insensitive substring of the quoted term in the rejection message; report 'unknown' if no quoted term), and the narration excerpt. Summary: n turns, n_first_pass_clean, n_retry_fired, n_rescued (committed_after_retry), n_failed_after_retry, rescue_rate = rescued / retry_fired (null when retry_fired == 0, never divide by zero), and n_second_reply_repeats_term. A rejected_turns entry with rejection_code INVALID_PROPOSAL and non-empty guard_rejections counts as failed_after_retry; one with empty guard_rejections is failed_other.
4. Hermetic tests in tests/test_guard_retry_telemetry.py (no network, no live worker): engine with the scripted provider used by tests/test_narration_retry.py records one rejection and resets it next turn; a clean turn has an empty list; report function on hand-built records gives the right outcome classes and rate, including the zero-retry case and the failed_after_retry case.

Run `TMPDIR=/tmp .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --no-cov` on your tests then the full tests/ directory, and `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check` and `ruff format` on changed files (use the main repo's .venv python with PYTHONPATH=$PWD).
